name: Gowlandflex
note: the record name carries the line name only, so a seller who types the maker AND the format ('Gowland Gowlandflex 4x5') scores 0.14 and loses to Graflex RB Tele 4 x 5 on the bare size token. Peter Gowland is the manufacturer; 4x5 is this camera's only format, so neither token narrows anything.

name: Folmer and Schwing Finger Print Camera
note: 'Fingerprint' as one word is the spelling every seller uses; the record has it as two. Same entity, 0.27 without the alias.

name: Graflex Anniversary PH-47E
note: PH-47E is the US Army Signal Corps designation for the Anniversary Speed Graphic. Sellers type the Signal Corps name off the body plate, which shares no model token with 'Anniversary' — 0.15 before the alias.

name: Graflex Speed Graphic Miniature
note: the 2x3 (6×9 cm) Speed Graphic is this record. Sellers name it by its format rather than 'Miniature', so the query collides with the unqualified 'Graflex Speed Graphic' record and lands at 0.28 on neither.

name: Graflex RB Super D 3 1/4 x 4 1/4
aliases: Graflex RB Super Graflex Series D
note: 'RB Super Graflex Series D' is how the camera is engraved and how it is listed; the record name is the catalogue form. Without the alias it scores 0.30 and loses to the plain 'Graflex Series D', which is the earlier non-Super body.

name: Graflex RB Super D 3 1/4 x 4 1/4
note: source carried format=35mm, which is self-contradictory against a name that states the sheet size. The RB Super D is a 3.25×4.25 in sheet-film reflex; the sibling 'Graflex Series D' record already carries format=sheet with that exact frame_size. Left uncorrected this keeps a large-format body out of every format facet.

name: Graflex RB Series D 3 1/4 x 4 1/4
note: same 35mm mis-tag as the Super D row above, same correction, same corroborating sibling record.
